question: Project Luxembourg's monthly imports from July 2026 to December 2028.

assumptions: monthly imports forecast from July 2026 to December 2028
fitted on the full series from 2002
monthly imports forecast from July 2026 to December 2028
fitted on the full series from 2002

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
The projection only extends past patterns. It is not an official forecast and includes no prices, policy or company decisions.

sql:
SELECT
  period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2002-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
GROUP BY
  period,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: 2.15 bn € Dec 2028
insight: Luxembourg's monthly imports are projected to be 2.15 billion euros in December 2028.
Total imports for 2027 and 2028 are projected to be 25.79 billion euros and 25.80 billion euros respectively, both about 2.8% higher than in 2025.
The imports for the last six months of 2026 are projected at 12.89 billion euros, following 2.22 billion euros in June 2026.
The projection is based on a statistical model using data from January 2002 to June 2026 and includes seasonal patterns.
These values are nominal euros and the projection does not account for price changes, policy, or company decisions, so it only extends past trends and is not an official forecast.
